==Swedish==

===Interjection===
{{head|sv|interjections}}

# [[oh]], [[wow]], [[gosh]] (expresses surprise, at something positive or negative)
#: {{uxi|sv|'''Oj''', verkligen?|'''Gosh''', really?}}
# [[oops]] (after making a mistake)
#: {{uxi|sv|'''Oj''', förlåt.|'''Oops''', sorry.}}
# {{senseid|sv|pain}} [[ow]] (expresses physical or mental pain or compassion)
#: {{syn|sv|aj|q=more common for physical pain}}
#: {{uxi|sv|'''Oj oj oj''', hur ska det gå för dem?|'''Oh dear''', '''oh dear''', how will they manage?}}

====Usage notes====
* Often repeated several times in ({{senseno|sv|pain}}).
* {{glossary|False friend}} with {{l+|en|oi}}.

====Synonyms====
* {{l|sv|ojdå}}
* {{l|sv|hoppsan}}
* {{l|sv|ack}} (pain, trouble)

====Derived terms====
* {{l|sv|oja|oja sig}}

====See also====
* {{l|sv|ojsan}}
* {{l|sv|wow}}
